// Part "Stairs and ladders": one straight flight per two-storey house (plan.md RESERVED), and the Magnolia attic ladder.
import { flight } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

const FLIGHTS = [
  [6, 15, "south"], [22, 15, "south"], [44, 18, "north"], [55, 15, "south"],
  [68, 15, "south"], [92, 19, "north"], [115, 15, "south"],
];

export function build(g) {
  for (const [x, z, facing] of FLIGHTS) {
    const r = flight(g, { from: [x, 2, z], facing, to: 5, material: "oak" });
    g.set(x, 5, z, "air"); // clearance over the first step (jump onto step 2)
    if (r.notes?.length) console.log("flight", x, z, r.notes);
  }
  // Magnolia attic: ladder up the partition face at (11, z18), through the attic floor hole at (11, 9, 17)
  for (let y = 6; y <= 10; y++) g.set(11, y, 17, "ladder", { facing: "north" });
}

input.summary:
P3 upper hall (gambrel landing, box 55..57 x 6..8 x 14..20) furnished in parts/room-26.mjs: spruce fence hall stand with a potted poppy between the north windows, fence-and-top-slab table with a lit candle in the SW, bench stair on the west wall, barrel dresser with a standing lantern and a linen chest in the SE, brown carpet runner up the lane.
`mcd room` says OK: 17 of 18 floor cells reachable, min light 8, no dark cell, FIT clean. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; my part placed 12 blocks with no REFUSED writes.
The room render reads as a landing: one focal stand at the north, furniture on the walls, clear lanes to the stair top and both east doors.
left: The palette has no banner, so the coat rack (fence + banner) became a spruce fence stand with a potted poppy; the first attempt was OFF-PALETTE brown_banner and was replaced.

The lantern stands on the barrel at (57,7,18) rather than hanging, because this copy has no ceiling block above the room to hang from. Re-check the lamp once the shell and roof are merged: if the ceiling is solid at y8, a hanging lantern would read better.

The window cells (55,6..7,14) and (57,6..7,14) are kept clear; the south wall (z21) may carry an upper window at x55..57 per the openings table, in which case the table (56,20) and chest (57,20) stand in front of it. Confirm after the merge.
`mcd room` reports unreached 57,8,18: this is the cell above the lantern on the barrel, a tool artifact rather than a walkable floor cell. The verdict still says OK.
I did not tick any elements.md or plan.md item: no item in those files names this room specifically.

waste.what: Worked out the 3x7 floor cells by hand from the plan grid: the stair column at x55 z15..17, the doorway first cells (57,15) and (57,19), the window cells (55,14) and (57,14), and the lane. I then wrote each layer's rows by hand.
waste.cost: About 6 coordinate decisions and two layers() calls; no retries on coordinates.
waste.tool: A `mcd plan --furnish` mode that takes a room name and a list of named blocks/roles (stair seat, table, lamp) and writes the layer rows plus the protected lane, doorway-first and window-inside cells automatically.

waste.what: Had to discover the palette gap (banner not in palette.json) by running make.sh, then rewrite the focal piece.
waste.cost: One full make.sh rebuild and one fix round.
waste.tool: A vocab check that compares each helper's block set against palette.json before writing (the coatRack helper used banner, which the palette lacks).

waste.what: Checked light and walk one at a time with separate calls, and the lantern-spot suggestion did not print because no ceiling exists in this copy.
waste.cost: Roughly 3 room/check runs; the lamp placement was chosen by hand from the light math.
waste.tool: `mcd room --lamp-spots` that reports lamp positions that clear the dark even without a ceiling (standing on a block), so the designer does not have to compute Manhattan falloff by hand.

companions.task: Confirm the ceiling at y8 once the shell and roof are merged, then hang the lantern from it instead of standing it on the barrel, and check the south-wall window (z21) light/walk.
Confirm the upper-floor ceiling and the gambrel slope cells above x55..57 so the hall's head clearance and the window openings on z13 and z21 are right before the furniture is final.
